Choose a layout cell by what it is for. Each category page gives one line per cell, its default layout, and a link to the cell's detailed page.

| Category | Choose it for | Cells |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Qubits](cells/qubits.qmd){.text-nowrap} | Placing a qubit and its junction | `disk_flip_chip_qubit`, `kosen2024_flip_chip_xmon_qubit`, `manhattan_style_junction` |
| [Resonators & Readout](cells/resonators-readout.qmd){.text-nowrap} | Readout and resonators | `resonator`, `resonator_hanger`, `resonator_meander`, `capacitive_coupling_intrinsic_individual_purcell_filter_readout_resonators` |
| [Capacitors & Couplers](cells/capacitors-couplers.qmd){.text-nowrap} | Capacitance and coupling | `interdigital_capacitor`, `martinis2022_differential_ribbon_capacitor` |
| [Lines & Connections](cells/lines-connections.qmd){.text-nowrap} | Launching, joining and coupling lines | `launcher`, `taper`, `cpw_t_junction`, `airbridge`, `n_trace_mtl_section`, `mtl_bend_coupling_section`, `mtl_straight_bend_coupling_section`, `mtl_straight_bend_transition`, `mtl_bend_bend_transition`, cross-sections |
| [Flip-chip & Packaging](cells/flip-chip-packaging.qmd){.text-nowrap} | Stacking dies and chip edges | `indium_bump`, `indium_ground`, `dicing_edge` |

## Elsewhere

Simulation-only cells are under [Simulation](../public-pdk-examples/test-components.md). Primitives such as `straight`, `bend_*`, `rounded_*`, `wire_corner` and `cpw_handoff` are under [Shared primitives](../public-pdk-examples/shared-primitives.md). Settings and ports stay in [API → Components](../public-pdk-examples/components/index.qmd).
